subject: Social Media
title: Surveillance Capitalism
description: Learn Surveillance Capitalism in one minute.

hook.text: You search for running shoes once. For weeks, shoe ads follow you across every app. Someone is watching.

buildup.text: Shoshana Zuboff coined 'surveillance capitalism'—the extraction of personal data for profit without consent.

discovery.text: Google discovered that behavioral data predicted clicks. What you do online reveals what you'll buy next.

twist.text: Companies don't just track behavior. They shape it. Nudges, prompts, and recommendations steer your choices.

climax.text: Zuboff warns this isn't just commerce. It's a new form of power—controlling behavior at scale, invisibly.

punchline.text: They don't just know what you want. They shape it.

quiz.question: What does surveillance capitalism extract for profit?
